author: jlslate
releaseNotes: Reliability hardening from community code review: command execution/polling converted from blocking pauseExecution loops to async HTTP + scheduled continuations (no longer ties up a platform thread for up to 45s per command), scheduledPoll now re-arms itself before doing work so one bad refresh can't silently kill the polling loop, polling resumes automatically after a hub reboot, and climate preset caching now persists reliably across app reloads.
